title: No SiriusXM
subtitle: SiriusXM off (North America only).
description: Turns off SiriusXM (US-only satellite radio): the module service (jciSXMS) and the manager (jciXMMGR) do not start at boot, and MMUI no longer loads the satradio, xmaudio and xmdata screen modules. Uninstall and restart to get the stock behaviour back.
